title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25

ai_review.summary: An upgraded soundboard capture of a polarizing second‑set Dark Star that leads into an unexpected MLB jam, making this underrated show worth a listen.
ai_review.review: The new SBD release is praised as a clear upgrade over earlier reel‑to‑reel/DAT sources, delivering good clarity throughout. Musically the second set is considered underrated and exciting by most reviewers, though one notes that the opening Dark Star feels overly minimalist and noisy, dampening its impact for some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Two of three reviewers rate the show/recording positively (4‑star), while one offers a more critical 3‑star view, leading to an overall weighted rating around 4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upgraded from previous reel/DAT/CD‑R versions; clear and balanced with no reported dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set opens with a stark, minimalist Dark Star that abruptly shifts into an energetic MLB jam; overall the set is viewed as underrated and enjoyable despite mixed feelings about the opening jam.
